name: checker
what: A fresh agent's lens, with its exact prompt as a template.

fields.name: prompt
fields.means: the template; {record} is the record's path

trace.author: agent
trace.note: A checker's prompt changes only by an event that names it.
trace.reflection: Every new one says what it supersedes or merges among the ones of its type that hold; every change to it is an event of an AIP in the same commit (D-40).
